extra_vocab.en: something you like to do in your free time
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於面試、同事閒聊和公司社團活動的情境，用來談論工作以外的興趣。語氣輕鬆、中性。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: hobby 是可數名詞，複數是 hobbies（y 改 ies）；說明嗜好時常用 My hobby is + V-ing，如 My hobby is reading。

example.en: Many of our staff have hobbies such as music and sports.
example.zh: 我們許多員工有音樂和運動之類的嗜好。

example.en: It is good to have a hobby after a busy week.
example.zh: 忙碌的一週之後，有一項嗜好是很好的。

example.en: He took up a new hobby after he retired last year.
example.zh: 他去年退休後開始了一項新的嗜好。

example.en: She turned her hobby into a successful online business.
example.zh: 她把嗜好變成一門成功的網路生意。

examples.en: In the interview, she talked about her hobby of photography.
examples.zh: 面試時，她談到自己攝影的嗜好。

examples.en: Do you have any hobbies outside of work?
examples.zh: 你工作之外有什麼嗜好嗎？

examples.en: The club helps employees share hobbies like cooking and hiking.
examples.zh: 這個社團幫助員工分享像烹飪和健行這類的嗜好。

confusable.diff: habit 是習慣（常常不自覺做的事）；hobby 是自己喜歡、特地花時間做的興趣。

example.en: Checking emails first thing in the morning is a habit of mine.
example.zh: 早上一到就先看電子郵件是我的習慣。

similar.diff: pastime 較書面，指消磨時間的休閒活動；hobby 通常是比較長期投入的興趣。

example.en: Reading is his favorite pastime on long business trips.
example.zh: 閱讀是他長途出差時最喜歡的消遣。

example.en: She has a strong interest in digital marketing.
example.zh: 她對數位行銷有濃厚的興趣。

example.en: The hotel offers many leisure activities for guests.
example.zh: 這間飯店為客人提供許多休閒活動。

example.en: The company plans a team activity for next month.
example.zh: 公司計畫下個月舉辦一場團隊活動。

extra_vocab.en: a pain in your head, or a problem that makes you worried
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於請假、健康和職場問題的情境。除了真的頭痛，也常比喻「麻煩事」，如 a big headache。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: headache 是可數名詞，要加冠詞：I have a headache（不是 I have headache）。

example.en: Small mistakes in orders created many headaches last month.
example.zh: 訂單中的小錯誤上個月造成許多麻煩。

example.en: Several staff members had a headache after the long meeting.
example.zh: 開完那場很長的會後，有幾位員工頭痛。

example.en: The software update turned out to be a big headache.
example.zh: 這次軟體更新最後變成一件大麻煩。

example.en: Missing parts can cause headaches for the whole production line.
example.zh: 缺少零件可能給整條生產線造成麻煩。

examples.en: I have a headache, so I will leave work early today.
examples.zh: 我頭痛，所以今天會提早下班。

examples.en: The new schedule system has been a headache for everyone.
examples.zh: 新的排程系統對每個人來說都很麻煩。

examples.en: Late shipments are a big problem and a headache for our sales team.
examples.zh: 延遲出貨是大問題，也讓我們的業務團隊很頭痛。

confusable.diff: 拼法開頭相同，但 headline 是新聞或文章的標題，不是頭痛。

example.en: The headline on the front page is about our new product.
example.zh: 頭版的標題是關於我們的新產品。

similar.diff: problem 是中性的「問題」；headache 是口語，強調讓人煩惱、很麻煩。

example.en: The shipping delay is a serious problem for us.
example.zh: 出貨延遲對我們來說是個嚴重的問題。

example.en: He has had back pain since the long flight.
example.zh: 自從那趟長途飛行後，他一直背痛。

example.en: Please take this medicine after you eat lunch.
example.zh: 請在吃完午餐後服用這個藥。

example.en: Too much stress can hurt your work performance.
example.zh: 過大的壓力會傷害你的工作表現。

example.en: I took some medicine because I had a bad headache.
example.zh: 我頭很痛，所以吃了一些藥。

senses.en: a person or thing that causes problems
senses.distinguish: 主詞是事情或系統，不是人在頭痛時，指麻煩事。

example.en: Changing suppliers in the middle of the year is a headache.
example.zh: 年中更換供應商是件很麻煩的事。

extra_vocab.en: able to hurt people or cause damage
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於產品警告標示、環保、食品安全和資訊安全的情境，常用 harmful to + 對象。語氣中性偏正式。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: harmful 後面接 to 加受害對象：harmful to your health、harmful to the environment，不用 for。

example.en: Long working hours can be harmful to your health.
example.zh: 長時間工作可能對你的健康有害。

example.en: The study found no harmful effects from the new material.
example.zh: 這項研究沒有發現這種新材料有任何有害影響。

example.en: Workers should avoid contact with harmful chemicals at all times.
example.zh: 員工任何時候都應避免接觸有害化學物質。

examples.en: The factory stopped using a harmful substance in its products.
examples.zh: 這間工廠已經不再在產品中使用有害物質。

examples.en: The label warns that the product may be harmful if swallowed.
examples.zh: 標籤警告這項產品若吞下可能有害。

examples.en: Delete any email that contains harmful links or files.
examples.zh: 請刪除任何含有有害連結或檔案的電子郵件。

confusable.diff: hurtful 指話語或行為「傷人感情的」；harmful 指對健康、環境等造成實際傷害。

example.en: His hurtful comment upset many of the staff members.
example.zh: 他傷人的評論讓許多員工感到難過。

similar.diff: dangerous 強調有立即的危險；harmful 強調可能造成傷害，可能是長期的。

example.en: It is dangerous to enter the site without a helmet.
example.zh: 沒戴安全帽進入工地很危險。

similar.diff: damaging 常用在對名聲、關係或結果的傷害，如 damaging to our image。

example.en: The false news was damaging to our company image.
example.zh: 這則假消息傷害了我們公司的形象。

example.en: There is a small risk of delay in shipping.
example.zh: 出貨有一點延遲的風險。

example.en: Toxic waste must be stored in sealed containers.
example.zh: 有毒廢棄物必須存放在密封的容器裡。

derived.link: 詞幹 harm，意思是「傷害」；也可當動詞「傷害」

extra_vocab.en: slow to act because you are not sure
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於會議、談判和客戶回應的情境，描述對決定或行動猶豫不決。常用 be hesitant to + V。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: be hesitant to 後面接原形動詞（hesitant to approve）；接名詞或 V-ing 時用 hesitant about。

example.en: Please do not be hesitant to contact me with questions.
example.zh: 有任何問題，請不要猶豫，隨時聯絡我。

example.en: Many investors are hesitant about entering the new market now.
example.zh: 許多投資人現在對進入新市場感到猶豫。

example.en: His hesitant reply showed that he was not ready.
example.zh: 他遲疑的回答顯示他還沒有準備好。

examples.en: Some managers were hesitant to approve the large budget.
examples.zh: 有些經理對批准這筆龐大預算感到猶豫。

examples.en: The client is hesitant about signing a long contract.
examples.zh: 客戶對簽一份長期合約感到猶豫。

examples.en: She gave a hesitant answer when asked about her salary.
examples.zh: 被問到薪水時，她給了一個遲疑的回答。

similar.diff: reluctant 是心裡不情願；hesitant 是因為不確定而遲疑。

example.en: Staff were reluctant to accept the new working hours.
example.zh: 員工不願意接受新的上班時間。

similar.diff: unsure 只是不確定；hesitant 強調因為不確定而遲遲不行動。

example.en: I am unsure about the delivery date for this order.
example.zh: 我不確定這筆訂單的交貨日期。

example.en: There is no doubt that sales will grow next year.
example.zh: 毫無疑問，明年的銷售會成長。

example.en: The bank is cautious about giving loans to new firms.
example.zh: 銀行對於貸款給新公司很謹慎。

derived.link: 詞幹 hesitate，動詞「猶豫」；常說 Don't hesitate to call me
hesitate 去掉 e 加 -ion，變成名詞，像 decide → decision

extra_vocab.en: a round sandwich with cooked meat inside
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於餐廳點餐、午餐和菜單的情境，口語常縮短成 burger。通常會搭配 fries 和飲料。

example.en: The restaurant sells over two hundred hamburgers on busy days.
example.zh: 這間餐廳在忙碌的日子能賣出兩百多個漢堡。

example.en: Let's order a hamburger and some coffee before the meeting.
example.zh: 我們開會前先點個漢堡和一些咖啡吧。

example.en: The lunch special comes with hamburger and fries for six dollars.
example.zh: 午間特餐是漢堡配薯條，只要六美元。

example.en: A new hamburger restaurant opened next to our office building.
example.zh: 一間新的漢堡餐廳開在我們辦公大樓旁邊。

examples.en: I would like a hamburger with fries and a small salad.
examples.zh: 我想要一個漢堡，配薯條和一份小沙拉。

examples.en: The cafeteria serves a cheap hamburger every Wednesday at noon.
examples.zh: 員工餐廳每週三中午供應一種便宜的漢堡。

examples.en: The new hamburger on our menu is made with local beef.
examples.zh: 我們菜單上的新漢堡是用本地牛肉做的。

similar.diff: burger 是 hamburger 的口語縮寫，菜單和日常對話都很常見，如 cheeseburger。

example.en: Our cafe is famous for its cheese burgers and milkshakes.
example.zh: 我們的咖啡店以起司漢堡和奶昔聞名。

similar.diff: sandwich 是用兩片麵包夾料的三明治；hamburger 是圓麵包夾肉排。

example.en: I usually eat a sandwich at my desk for lunch.
example.zh: 我午餐通常在座位上吃三明治。

example.en: The cafe offers a free sandwich with every coffee.
example.zh: 這間咖啡店每杯咖啡附贈一個三明治。

example.en: Would you like fries or a salad with that?
example.zh: 您的餐點要配薯條還是沙拉？

example.en: Every lunch set at this cafe includes a free beverage.
example.zh: 每份午餐套餐都附一杯免費飲料。

extra_vocab.en: a person who owns the house or apartment they live in
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於銀行貸款、保險、房地產和住宅維修的情境，也常出現在社區公告。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: homeowner 是一個字，不寫成 home owner；保險常寫成 homeowners insurance（homeowners 後面不加撇號）。

example.en: Several homeowners joined the meeting about the new street plan.
example.zh: 有幾位屋主參加了關於新街道規劃的會議。

example.en: A first-time homeowner can get help from this program.
example.zh: 首次購屋的人可以從這個方案獲得協助。

example.en: Homeowners insurance usually covers damage from fire and storms.
example.zh: 住宅保險通常涵蓋火災和暴風雨造成的損害。

example.en: The homeowners association meets on the first Monday of each month.
example.zh: 社區管理委員會在每個月的第一個週一開會。

examples.en: The bank offers low interest rates to many homeowners.
examples.zh: 這間銀行向許多屋主提供低利率。

examples.en: Most homeowners buy insurance to protect against fire.
examples.zh: 大多數屋主會買保險來預防火災。

examples.en: The homeowner agreed to sell the house at a lower price.
examples.zh: 屋主同意以較低的價格賣掉這棟房子。

examples.en: Contractors usually give homeowners a written cost estimate first.
examples.zh: 承包商通常會先給屋主一份書面的費用估價。

confusable.diff: landlord 是把房子出租給別人的房東；homeowner 是自己擁有並居住的屋主。

example.en: The landlord raised the rent for the office by ten percent.
example.zh: 房東把辦公室的租金調漲了百分之十。

example.en: Each tenant must pay the rent by the fifth.
example.zh: 每位房客都必須在五號前繳房租。

example.en: They paid off their mortgage after twenty years.
example.zh: 他們二十年後還清了房貸。

example.en: The company bought a large property near the port.
example.zh: 公司在港口附近買了一大塊房地產。

extra_vocab.en: a small book that gives rules or useful facts about a subject
extra_vocab.note: 多益非常常見於公司規定、人資和訓練的情境，最常見的是 employee handbook（員工手冊）。語氣中性、偏正式。

example.en: The HR office printed new handbooks for all the trainees.
example.zh: 人資部為所有受訓人員印了新的手冊。

example.en: The employee handbook lists all the company holidays.
example.zh: 員工手冊列出了所有的公司假日。

example.en: Please refer to the handbook if you have any questions.
example.zh: 如果有任何問題，請查閱手冊。

example.en: Every worker must read the safety handbook before starting.
example.zh: 每位員工開始工作前都必須閱讀安全手冊。

examples.en: New staff receive an employee handbook on the first day.
examples.zh: 新進員工第一天會拿到一本員工手冊。

examples.en: Please check the handbook for the rules about sick leave.
examples.zh: 請查閱手冊中關於病假的規定。

examples.en: The training handbook explains each step of the sales process.
examples.zh: 訓練手冊說明了銷售流程的每一個步驟。

confusable.diff: handout 是會議或課堂上發的單張資料或講義；handbook 是比較完整的手冊。

example.en: I will give everyone a handout before the presentation.
example.zh: 簡報開始前，我會發給大家一份講義。

similar.diff: manual 多指產品或機器的操作說明書；handbook 多指規定和一般資訊的手冊。

example.en: The manual shows how to set up the new printer.
example.zh: 這本說明書教你如何安裝新的印表機。

example.en: Please read the manual before you use this machine.
example.zh: 使用這台機器前，請先閱讀操作說明書。

example.en: The company has a clear policy on working from home.
example.zh: 公司對在家工作有明確的規定。

example.en: All staff must follow the new safety guidelines.
example.zh: 所有員工都必須遵守新的安全指導方針。

extra_vocab.en: a device you wear over your ears to listen to sound
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於電子產品、辦公室規定和線上會議的情境。通常用複數 headphones，一副耳機說 a pair of headphones。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: headphone 通常用複數 headphones，動詞用複數（The headphones are new）；數量用 a pair of headphones。

example.en: Customers can try the headphones before they decide to buy.
example.zh: 顧客在決定購買前可以先試戴耳機。

example.en: I bought a pair of headphones for online meetings.
example.zh: 我買了一副耳機來開線上會議。

example.en: These wireless headphones can last for twenty hours.
example.zh: 這款無線耳機可以使用二十小時。

example.en: Noise-cancelling headphones help me focus in a busy office.
example.zh: 降噪耳機幫助我在忙碌的辦公室裡專心。

examples.en: Please use headphones when you watch videos at your desk.
examples.zh: 在座位上看影片時，請使用耳機。

examples.en: I always bring headphones to listen to music on flights.
examples.zh: 我搭飛機時總是帶著耳機聽音樂。

examples.en: Use your headphones to join the online call from home.
examples.zh: 請用耳機從家裡加入線上通話。

confusable.diff: microphone 是麥克風，用來收音；headphones 是耳機，用來聽聲音。

example.en: Please speak into the microphone so everyone can hear you.
example.zh: 請對著麥克風說話，這樣大家都聽得到你。

similar.diff: headset 是附有麥克風的耳機，常用在客服和視訊會議。

example.en: The call center staff all wear a headset with a microphone.
example.zh: 客服中心的員工都戴著附麥克風的耳機。

similar.diff: earphones 是塞進耳朵的入耳式耳機，比 headphones 小。

example.en: Each trainee received earphones for the language course.
example.zh: 每位學員都拿到語言課程用的耳機。

example.en: The speaker in the meeting room is too quiet.
example.zh: 會議室裡的喇叭聲音太小了。

example.en: Please turn down the volume during the video call.
example.zh: 視訊通話時，請把音量調小。

example.en: The audio of the recording is not clear.
example.zh: 這段錄音的音訊不清楚。
